newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing sells property for HK$241 mln.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing sells property for HK$241 mln.

text.p: Diversified property and construction group Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had sold a Hong Kong property for HK$241 million.
Its Hong Kong subsidiary, Tuan Sing (H.K.) Ltd, sold the 28th floor of Nine Queens Road Central, with total gross floor area of 13,769 square feet to Handy View Company Ltd.
A company statement said the estimated net profit before tax attributable to the property disposal, after deducting costs, would be about Singapore $10 million.
The net proceeds would be used for other investments.
The sale will increase the earnings per share to 4.1 cents from 3.4 cents and the net tangible assets per share to about 49.7 cents from 49 cents for financial year ended December 31, 1996, it said.
